subject: Change default Valkey to 9.0.1 release (#528)
reason: The change is a CI version bump (scripts/common.rc, testing/integration/run.sh set default Valkey to 9.0.1) plus raising kMinimumServerVersion in src/version.h from 8.1.1 to 9.0.1. That constant is read only once, in vmsdk/src/module.cc's load-time gate: if the server version is below it, module load fails with VALKEYMODULE_ERR; nothing after a successful load uses it. The only observable difference is on a server whose version lies in [8.1.1, 9.0.1), where the parent module loads and the changed one is refused.
